fee_notes: Royalty ramps: 2% AGR year 1, 3% AGR year 2, then 6% AGR or graduated 4-6% from year 3+. Graduated rate available if prior-year cumulative AGR across all centers exceeds $1M. General System Fund: up to 2% AGR capped at $7,344/center (FY2026 cap, never to exceed $7,500). Local advertising: at least 3% AGR annually. National Advertising Fund not yet established as of issuance date. Signage lease: estimated $375-$650/month for 120-month term.
raw_excerpt: Royalties: For the first 12 months, 2% of AGR; for the second 12 months, 3% of AGR, then 6% of AGR or a graduated royalty rate between 4% and 6% of AGR. General System Fund: Up to 2% of AGR; annual cap $7,344. Local Advertising Spend: At least 3% of AGR annually.
